name: deezcuts-tempo-slider
description: Browser extension (Chrome and Firefox) that adds a tempo slider to the SoundCloud embed widget.

scripts.lint: npm run build -- firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir packages --filename firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir packages --filename chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
